From: Oliver Hughes <oliver@thamesreads.example>
To: jacob@ledgerly.example
Subject: Manuscript proofreading

Hello,

Please go ahead with the following:

Proofreading: 18 hours @ £40/hr
Style sheet preparation: 2 hrs @ £40/hr

We pay within 30 days of invoice.

Kind regards,
Oliver Hughes

From: Priya Nair <priya@orbitlabs.example>
To: jacob@ledgerly.example
Subject: Two workstreams, two budgets

Hi Jacob,

Our US entity and EU entity are paying separately:

- 20 hours of React development at $95/hr
- 6 hours of localisation QA at €60/hr

Net 30 for both.

Thanks,
Priya
